title: Set canonical site URL to swamisamarth.icp.app

requirements.text: Update the site HTML metadata to reflect the chosen production domain "swamisamarth.icp.app" by adding a canonical URL and Open Graph URL pointing to https://swamisamarth.icp.app.

quotes: what is link to open on browser

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a <link rel="canonical" href="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> tag.
frontend/index.html includes a <meta property="og:url" content="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> tag.
The site still loads correctly at the root path (/) and existing routes continue to work.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor (no new backend services).
nonGoals: Rebranding the site name/content away from the existing "AutoFit Accessories" content.
Changing navigation structure or existing pages beyond adding URL metadata.
